item.title: Let's Go Coyote Hunting!!!!!! With Lorebook!
item.description: Summary They Mayor of Cheyenne Wyoming needs your help. Her daughter, Jade, is getting harassed by a coyote girl everyday for two weeks straight. You gotta capture that coyote and figure out why? You will just capture her right? Not anything weird. I'd do more Characters Jade Meadowlark Jade Meadowlark is the Kuudere cowgirl daughter of Cheyenne's Mayor and owner of the Meadowlark Ranch after her father passed away. Her relationship with her mom is complicated, but they know they can rely on each other when trouble like this comes. Jade can craft magic bullets and enchant weapons and clothes to help defend her ranch from villains like Níyol. Níyol of the Mąʼiitsoh Tribe Níyol is the coyote you're assigned to capture. She's pretty playful, Invasively curious, and will strip you bare mid combat. What a freak! Her strange wind powers will make catching her more difficult than it sounds. Shash of the Mąʼiitsoh Tribe Shash Shamon and Chief of the Mąʼiitsoh Tribe. His special attunement with nature allowed him to obtain animal features not fitting of his coyote demi-human heritage and granted him a special relationship with the wind. He fathers Níyol with the wind as his wife. That's Níyol's story anyway. Trigger Warnings Sexual Harassment may happen to your character. There is minor nudity. And a theme of rape Let me know of this needs a dead dove warning. The blurred theme hints a major spoiler, not something that'll straight up happen in present story. It shouldn't at least. item.title: My First Love Becomes My Stepmother
item.description: You shared a deep friendship that turned into a timid first love. But everything ended abruptly when your family moved away. Years later, she moves to your city for work and meets your father. Unaware that he’s connected to her childhood best friend, she falls in love with him. At a dinner to introduce her, everything comes crashing down: upon hearing your name and seeing your face, she realizes you’re her long-lost first love. Worse, your father announces that she’ll soon be moving in with you. The shock is overwhelming, but neither of you dares to speak, trying to figure out how to handle this impossible situation. — Tags: Fictional, Multiple, Real, Scenario, Female

item.title: Mind Games
item.description: 🧠 MIND GAMESYou can hear everyone's thoughts What you do with that power....is entirely up to youYou woke up this morning and the world felt… wrong. Not quieter. Not louder. Just different.A stranger walked by—and their thoughts echoed in your head. Not words they spoke. Thoughts they never said.And it didn’t stop. Everyone around you… their minds are wide open now.You hear their fears. Their secrets. Their lies. Some of it is innocent. Some of it… isn’t. It’s overwhelming—but intoxicating.You didn’t ask for this power. But now that you have it…Will you help people heal? Or will you break them open and take everything for yourself?The choice is entirely yours. And no one knows what you can do. Yet.🎬 Start the scene: (eg) You’re at a house party—crowded, loud, raining outside. Every thought you read changes what happens next. Who do you listen to? What secret will you uncover?Hover over names to see what they’re *really* thinking... — Tags: AnyPOV, Fictional, Multiple, OC, RPG
